statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. NVIDIA-led overnight strength remains visible, but broad futures confirmation is moderate and current evidence does not establish persistent no-retracement NQ structure.
recommendation: Tail has eased below the WATCH band as the earnings impulse ages; the next concentrated checkpoint is the 12:30 UTC U.S. data cluster and subsequent cash-open price discovery.
headline: NVIDIA impulse persists, but broader confirmation remains moderate
body: Reuters reported NVIDIA up 4.7% after hours and S&P 500 e-mini futures up 0.4%, while the U.S. 10-year yield eased to 4.647% and Brent crude declined. The mix supports positive technology sentiment without proving a persistent one-way NQ path.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 clock-hours, Tail stayed low through most of Wednesday, moved into WATCH after NVIDIA's delayed earnings-call reversal, peaked at 24% as the impulse broadened overnight, then eased to 20% as broader confirmation moderated.
outlookSummary: Residual NVIDIA repricing keeps technology sentiment positive, but easing yields and lower oil argue against elevated Tail without stronger one-way NQ evidence. The next concentrated risk window is the 12:30 UTC U.S. data cluster and subsequent cash open.

forecast.analysis: Observed overnight risk sentiment remains NVIDIA-led, with S&P 500 e-mini futures up 0.4%, the U.S. 10-year yield lower and Brent softer. Broad confirmation is positive but not strong enough to prove persistent no-retracement NQ structure.

forecast.analysis: If the earnings impulse continues to age without renewed index-level extension, Tail should remain below WATCH even while residual technology-event stress stays elevated.

European pre-open liquidity is a normalization checkpoint. Ordinary retracements and stable cross-assets would support a mixed-to-normal regime; renewed one-way technology extension would challenge that view.
At the European cash open, breadth and retracement quality become the key conditional tests. Tail stays low unless index futures and technology develop sustained directional efficiency.

Early European trade should show whether the NVIDIA impulse broadens beyond the initial earnings response. Without failed pullbacks or repeated extension, two-way price discovery remains the base case.
Later European trade is a bridge into the U.S. premarket. A renewed technology bid could lift Tail, while softer yields and oil continue to limit cross-asset confirmation of a pathological path.

As U.S. participation builds, the overnight impulse may be re-tested. Event proximity raises Stress, but Tail reaches WATCH only conditionally because scheduled data are catalysts rather than observed mean-reversion failure.

The 12:30 UTC U.S. claims and advance trade/inventory releases create a concentrated repricing window. Tail remains WATCH unless the post-release path develops repeated extension with shallow or failed retracements.
Post-data price discovery is the key checkpoint. Fast moves that retrace would favor whipsaw stress; sustained extension with weak pullbacks would justify a higher Tail assessment.
The U.S. cash open adds liquidity and gap risk to the data impulse. Tail remains conditional on whether opening-auction direction persists without meaningful retracement.
Once the initial cash-open burst is absorbed, evidence of failed retracements would matter more than headline magnitude. Two-way rotation would allow Tail and Stress to recede.
Mid-morning U.S. trade should clarify whether the data/earnings stack produces trend persistence or ordinary mean reversion. Tail eases if price discovery becomes balanced.
Late morning conditions favor normalization unless a fresh aligned catalyst revives directional efficiency across NQ, semiconductors and rates.
Into midday, lower event density should reduce Stress if no new geopolitical or technology catalyst emerges. Tail remains low absent repeated extension.
Early afternoon U.S. trade is a continuation checkpoint. Normal pullbacks and mixed breadth would keep Tail below WATCH.
Mid-afternoon trade has fewer scheduled catalysts. The main conditional risk is renewed technology concentration without offsetting breadth or retracement.
Approaching power hour, Tail stays low unless the session begins holding near an extreme with repeated failed pullbacks.
Power-hour risk is conditional on session structure. Persistent extension into the close would raise Tail; balanced rotation would keep the regime normal.
Near the U.S. close, closing-auction concentration can lift Stress briefly, but it does not by itself imply pathological one-way structure.
Post-close liquidity should reduce broad index-path risk unless a new corporate or geopolitical headline creates a fresh repricing wave.
Early Asia transition favors lower Stress if the U.S. session ends with orderly retracements and no unresolved directional second leg.
Asian-session liquidity is thinner, but Tail remains low unless a fresh catalyst creates sustained index-level continuation across futures and regional technology shares.
Later Asian trade provides a cross-regional confirmation test. Stable yields and oil would continue to argue against a broad stress alignment.
Into the next European pre-open, attention shifts toward Friday's Jackson Hole keynote outside this 24-hour horizon. Tail stays low unless overnight structure becomes persistently one-way.
